item.create_mobile_packages_unofficial.d: When sneak clicked on a Stock Link or Stock Ticker
Controller will bind to the Network
Controller will open a mobile Stock Keeper menu
create_mobile_packages_unofficial.ponder: The Drone Port sends Packages to Players
Set the Package address to the Player's name
The Package will be sent to the Player by drone
A player who purchases a package can be automatically assigned as the package address
Start with the shop’s inventory, a Packager and Stock link
Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop
Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper
Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold
To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth
In the Package Address box, type @player
Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side
Other players can now interact with the shop
When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package with their username as the address
From there, they can be transported to a drone port, and sent to the player

For use with the Frogport, when setting up the Tablecloth, put a package address before the @player (such as Shop@player), then in the Frogport name it Shop*. The Droneport automatically removes any text before and including the @
